definitions.text: være nervøs, særlig etter en påkjenning
definitions.translation: to be nervous, especially after a stressful experience (lit. to have frayed or worn-out nerves)

examples.no: etter ulykken har jeg hatt tynnslitte nerver
examples.en: Since the accident, I have had frayed nerves.

examples.no: ledelsen har hatt frynsete nerver den siste tiden
examples.en: The management has had frayed nerves for some time now.
